title.narrative: Inclusive Horizons – Strengthening Elections and Peace in Somaliland

description.narrative: Inclusive Horizons – Strengthening Elections and Peace in Somaliland is a timely response to Somaliland’s political landscape challenges. The project proposes a locally rooted, conflict-sensitive approach to advancing inclusive governance, electoral transparency, and grassroots peacebuilding. It aligns with Somaliland’s priorities and builds on momentum generated by earlier interventions. The main objective of the project is Increased short-to-medium term political stability through peaceful political settlements and reconciliation

activity-date.narrative: The project officially commenced on 1st october 2025 and the activities began implemented
This is the date of the project closure

recipient-country.narrative: The project is carried out in Somalia specifically in Somaliland with a focus on strengthening electoral processes and peace building initiatives.

sector.narrative: In partnership with the Somaliland National Peace Committee (SNPC), the project also focused on conflict resolution and peace dialogues in the Sanaag and Awdal regions by engaging traditional elders, women, youth representatives, and government officials.

Local civil society organizations collaborated in this project to strengthen local ownership of democratic processes by advocating for inclusivity and supporting women and minority candidates for the 2026 parliamentary and local council elections. They engaged directly with democratic institutions, including the National Electoral Commission and political parties.
